name: Immunodeficiency due to CD25 deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in IL2RA (CD25) gene
Absent or markedly reduced CD25 expression on activated T cells
Recurrent severe infections with opportunistic pathogens and autoimmune manifestations
Elevated serum IgE and eosinophilia with impaired T cell proliferation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic IL2RA mutations plus clinical immunodeficiency and absent CD25 expression on T cells
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of genetic, immunophenotypic, and clinical data

pathognomonic.symptomName: Absent CD25 (IL-2 receptor alpha) expression on activated T lymphocytes
searchTerms: missing IL-2 receptor on immune cells
absent CD25 on activated T cells

pathognomonic.notes: Including viral, fungal, and bacterial pathogens
searchTerms: severe repeated infections from weak germs
chronic diarrhea due to intestinal problems

occasional.notes: Due to chronic illness and malabsorption

rare.symptomName: Neurological complications such as seizures or developmental delay
rare.notes: Secondary to infections or autoimmune encephalitis
searchTerms: brain problems like seizures or delayed development

rare.notes: Chronic lung damage from recurrent infections

searchTerms: hormone gland problems like thyroid inflammation

laboratory: Absent or markedly reduced CD25 expression on activated T cells by flow cytometry
Impaired T cell proliferation in response to IL-2 stimulation
Autoimmune cytopenias on peripheral blood smear
imaging: Chest CT may show bronchiectasis or pulmonary infiltrates
other: Histopathology of gut biopsy showing lymphocytic infiltration and enteropathy

distinguishingFeatures: More profound T and B cell lymphopenia
Absence of T cells rather than dysfunctional T cells with absent CD25
Early onset with failure to thrive and life-threatening infections
Severe early-onset autoimmunity including type 1 diabetes
Presence of regulatory T cell defects distinct from CD25 deficiency

redFlags: Severe, recurrent opportunistic infections in infancy
Autoimmune cytopenias resistant to standard therapy
Absent CD25 expression on activated T cells
references: Sharfe N, et al. Immunodeficiency due to IL2RA (CD25) deficiency. J Clin Immunol. 2017.
Orphanet: Immunodeficiency due to CD25 deficiency. ORPHA:169100.
Kovanen PE, Leonard WJ. Cytokines and immunodeficiency diseases: IL-2 receptor alpha chain deficiency. Immunol Rev. 2004.
